content: <@476553068687654922> Good night! You'll get a ping when your 8 hours pass.
<@476553068687654922> Hello! Your long rest is over now, have a great new day in Empire City!
Mictlan moves over to a pond, places some of their stuff nearby that would be a hassle to dry out, and does a winged flip to land quietly inside. Bleh, wet feathers.
(let me know when the hour is up)
(Okay, I will!)
They wade around in the pond before they find something that looks kind of neat and sticks it in a pocket for further crafting purposes.
Mictlan fiddles with their robes after a few minutes, conjuring up still images of feathers and eyes and wishing they had the resources to summon their cousin back right now. Ah, well.
They ponder, then move to <#863541645080920105> to check out their ship.
(1/5 done)
(Yay.)
Grimlock wanders over to Murry Hill park, then shakes her head and returns to stalking around the city.
I arrive at the park, intending to have a closer look at the outside of the cottage.

After pacing around it a few times, admiring the natural beauty of the construction, I move over to the pavilion and unwrap my Copper's Chopped Cheese sandwich from yesterday. It smells like onions and foot. I eat it ravenously.

After I feel much stronger, though if it is because I have eaten for the first time in days or because I have survived the meal who can say. Magically whisking the crumbs and globs away, I stand and move back towards the streets. I want to have a look at the bomb sites, then stop by <#863311533328695367>

I manage to half-drag, half-carry the lifeless body of <@!594008151779573762> to the pavilion in Murray Hill Park. I arrange her limbs in repose and play a few sad bars on my horn. I wipe tears from my eyes as I remember again the image of the Tatankan eaten alive by monstrous sewer creatures.
I smile as I leave the park, for the <#863581290645291018> eager to do it again soon.
( <@!594008151779573762> let me know if you want to talk to the chinn that lives here)
The Mender tends to the body here, casting a spell to preserve the body, wondering if the spirit will come to talk, or if he will need to send the body elsewhere
( <@!237577351532249110> here! so this is the ghost permitted area? <:ninPFFFTGhost:533582787534520340> )
(yes, The Mender has enchanted this place to be one where the veil between the two worlds is thinner, and spirits may directly talk to the living)
The mender looks up at the spirit of <@!594008151779573762>  "ah... my friend... here for a chat... or reintegration with the living?"

*`”...talk, I suppose...”`*
The spirit’s voice rings out from an indistinct direction, despite the obvious translucent figure in the cemetery. She sits, knees to her chest, next to a grave that is not hers.
Roy appears, visibly uneasy, and slightly limping in one knee for some reason.
the chinokin smiles then hold up a patella and looks at <@!148682928434577408> "And I take it this is yours?"
"I suppose so. I had some weird feeling that it was somewhere else."

his attention shifts from spirit to spirit, looking at the depressed one and the swarmed one "I quite like taking.... and I do disslike... people being stuck between worlds."  he pauses "if either of you need life once again.... i am happy to discuss it.... til then.... what brings you to my park?"
(am I swarmed though, I thought I'd be bugs-free here)
(Your spirit is that of a swarm in the chinns eyes)
(I see) (well the chinn does but)
Meorys emerges from behind a tree, torso looking deformed.

Talia’s gaze swivels immediately to the new ghosts as they appear. Once she half-recognizes each one, though, some unbearable disappointment crosses her face, and her eyes return to the floor.
*`”...just looking.”`*
"What a nice day for friends to visit, come join us" he beckons <@!740639937677754539>
"and you swarm spirit?  what brings you to my park?  a new body?" he says to <@!148682928434577408>
"This place... it's different than all the others. I feel life here. Everywhere else, I only felt cold."
"Life is one of my, specialties.  I devoted myself to protecting it both in life and in death"
"Can you give it back? Life, I mean."
"Honestly, uh, mister? Madam? Sorry, never seen people like you before. I'm not sure whether I should be coming back. But at the same time it doesn't look like I can move on either."

he looks at the two of you "Yes, I can give life back to the unliving, at a small price.  I invest part of myself in them... and as long as they can follow my tenants.... they continue to live."  he pauses "and one thing I believe is no one... should die early"
"What's the price? I... I don't know if I could exist like this any longer."

"faith.. in a fahion.  I take a piece of me, and give you new life.  You meditate, while mostly in water... and in silence each day when you wake for 5 days.... you follow my path.... and your life will continue"
"would you like to hear what the path entails?"
"Your offer sounds very kind and generous. I wish I could take it without second thought, but I feel like that piece of you would be wasted."
"I'm not much of a person of faith. But if you could bring me back to life, then maybe I'll finally believe in something."
(btw, <@!594008151779573762> you are welcome to comment and take advantage of the offer too.  if not, The Mender will chat with you after)
Talia’s spirit does listen, but doesn’t speak, gaze still downcast.

the chinn smiles "the first part of the path" he says while looking at <@!148682928434577408> "is that Life is precious.  People should always act to preserve life.  This does not mean lives wont be taken…. Only that to take a life, you must be saving more than is lost.  This is because we are all one…. We are all one…. School.  I dedicated my time in this realm and the one beyond to saving lives, and healing souls.  I found my serenity making other people's lives better…. But I also understood that some beings cannot continue… if we wish to serve the greater good.  Every person is part of every person"
"so it would never be a waste to bring someone back that values life"
Meorys nods
"The swarm cares for its members, but in return each member understands they're part of a swarm and care for it too. And yet, I'm not sure if I really valued my own."

"you dont value yourself..... many of my friends were the same.... I don't know if they learned their value... but you need to learn yours.... you talk of the insects.... the hive you are a part of....this bings me to my next part of the path: We are a part of nature and the natural order.  Be kind to the world around you.  Respect it… the trees…. Grass…. Moss…. Rivers…. We are all part of the ocean of life…. So do what you can to protect it.  All life…. From the smallest of small to biggest of big…. Is connected."
"the fact you value our little friends means you are a better person than most when it comes to respecting nature"
"Nature... natural order. But the world we live in now. The soldiers that bring terror on our streets, bombs the parks and burns the trees. Will it be our duty to end their destruction?"

"Friends. In a way you're right, but I never thought of it like that. Just like part of myself. And yet look, in my chase for a bigger swarm to be a part of I brought them here with me. And you seem like one who knows a lot, so you probably know that I was... or am, a mechanic. I turned away from the mindset of my elders to pursue technology as my focus. I never turned my back on nature, but still. I wish for it to be part of the world, not its enemy. I... don't know what to think of it."

his eyes turn fierce "I died in war... I was brought back in a time of war..... I spent hundreds of years aiding angels in their war on devils.... tho only a fraction of that time passed here... I was told that I am a child of war, and bound to it.... a Man of peace forever stuck in battle.... Knowing when to take a life for the greater good is respecting life itself.  The next part of my path is that no person should be a slave to another person.  I have seen many people broken by chains and whips… and no one should ever be in the bondage of another person's tyranny.  My people were in bondage and I left to find help.  Help never came.  The war that took my original life was between other slavers, and people they were trying to enslave and kill.  I spent my life fighting for freedom, and gave my life fighting for freedom from my own fate.  Freedom is worth fighting for."
"I knew someone once.... he was one of the kindest hearts... and he was mechanical.... Gadgets and Gizmos have their place in nature, as long as they aren't made to destroy nature"
"Then I will give my all to the fight, if that is how I can honor you."
The mender gets a big fish smile
Meorys smiles back at the mender

"You must also know mercy.  Mercy is not weakness.  Showing mercy should not be seen as weakness.  It is easier to act out of anger and fear…. Than it is to control them and show compassion.  Do not look down upon those that show mercy…. And recognize when you should show mercy.  I rarely gave in to my anger, and the one time I did…. I didn't live to make amends.  A lifetime of patience and practiced mercy… lost in a moment of fear and weakness.  Remember those you fight are people.  Are lives.  fight for freedom, but know when to show mercy"
"Patience... patience is something I could use. It is because of my lack of patience that I am here."

"I have no wish to be an enemy to nature. And I cannot disagree with your next tenet. People of my homeland have seen their fellows' freedom taken from them. Even before the wars of the gods of the old world. That's why all our swarms protect one another. And these chains holding this city... In a way, they got me here."
Roy sighs. (to break this block of text into paragraphs for better readability)

"I was not the bravest, so far from my swarm and on my own... Bah. I was a coward. And probably still am. But eventually these bonds drove me to carelessness, just so I could follow what I thought would be freedom. I would not stand for taking others' freedom. But I just don't know if I have the strength to fight the uncertain for the sake of freedom of others. I wish I did, but I don't know if I really do."

"I died fearing my fate.... everyone is a coward at times, and noone should be punished for running and hiding.... I don't ask for bravery... I ask for goodness.  I also ask for one last thing that might be the most important"
he pauses, and takes a deep breath

"You must embrace the day.... I didn't know my last day had come for me.... It left me with things unsaid, a woman never knowing how I felt.... I should have done more with the time I had....  No penance will let you fogive the things undone."

"I- I think I understand. But I am scared. I lived my life without a care if the day I had was my last. I was careless, too confident. What if I made the same mistake, and it happens again? You're power will be wasted on me."
The chinn smiles "I have made mistakes.... I have not followed my path.... you only will fade if you step off so far you are lost.... as long as the path is in sight, youll find your way back"

"Before I was enamored with machines, I used to hunt for food. We would get attacked sometimes, by beasts protecting their young. As is normal. I haven't forgotten that not every beast on a hunter's path needs to die. I want to think I would be the same towards people as well... To be honest, I don't think I've ever actually aimed my bow at a person that could be talked to."
Roy laughs a bit.
"That might explain a lot, I suppose. And trying to embrace the day... through my stupidity, got me here. I wish I could confidently say the same to your last point as I did to the first two. I'm just... Yes, what the fellow spirit here says. Maybe I wasn't ready to embrace each day, not knowing how to do it right."
"As long as the path is in sight, I will find my way back." Meorys mirrors his words.
"So if any of you can follow, life, mercy, freedom, nature, and seizing the day..... let me know, and I can bring you back, with words to help you.... attune to the path"

“And what difference will it make?,” chimes the mostly-silent specter, voice hoarse.
“What is there in giving yourself to something? A cause, a way of life, a value?
...it will only lead us here again.”
"Another day to make a differance.... another day to help.... If you find one person to show kindness to before you come back.... it was worth it"
"We're here because we cannot pass on... because we have business we didn't take care of. We didn't seize the days we had." Meorys pauses.
"the worst that happens it you end back here..... that measn that anything else is a step up.... nothing to lose but to try"
The chinn claps at Zine "you understand"
"I think... I think he is giving us another chance to amend that."
"Thank you," she smiles at him.
gives a polite nod in agreement
"What would happen to you, then? With each piece you'd give us, when we'd return here. Would it not hurt you, or hinder your power to help others?"

“And you would turn us, the hypocrites, to nobly follow your way?
Specters on a hill, who gave all they had, and realized they wanted it back?”
Her rough tone is bemused.
he pulls out a bag of good berries and eats one "By Web yes.... I would give everyone a second chance if i could.... people always deserve second chances"
"You too are one who makes the berries?"
smiles "I have been known to make a few..."
"Who is this *Web* you speak of?" she asks curiously
Talia’s spirit stands, slowly, with labor, rather than sitting now.
An exceptionally cute mushroom enters the park. They wander around touching trees before walking over to the group
(Plumber is headed to my house... I need abotu 15 mins to get home)
Tabula just kind of plops on the ground next to everyone

"I've done it too. Well, "we" is the right word here. I wish I could make and share some with others here, but... well, even before I got here I was almost completely powerless. I oppose none of the parts of your path, but I don't know if I can confidently say I have the strength to follow the last one."

Grimlock the dinosaur also finds herself wandering into the park. Led entirely on instinct, she walks up to a pond and starts to drink.

She doesn't seem to have taken in much of her surroundings, save for the need to drink and the presence of water.
"Hello, mushroom friend"
A small ceramic man shuffles into the park and makes his way to Tabula.
"Heloooooooo. Who are you" Tabulas face is expressive and inquisitive
“He wishes to provide us the chance, regardless of doubt. If we do not understand why in time, I am sure we will return.”
"Oh, hello. Good day to you all on the right side. And hello Grimlock. Good to see you're fine."
"I don't know just yet."
"*Hehe* me either!"
"Also welcome Nolan! Glad you found me"
Bo hops in from the entrance, curious of all the voices he hears. His ears perk up at the sight of so many.
